wft_alert_hint: The workflow’s name and the run’s error. Telegram and a conversation work as in a Send message step.
wft_delete_body: Its address stops answering and its delivery log is deleted. The sender keeps sending until you remove the webhook there too.
wft_rules_hint: Each rule compares a path — trigger.event, trigger.task_id, trigger.body.…, steps.<id>.output — with a value. Yes follows the green connections, no the red ones; a no with nothing after it ends the run as “filtered”.
wft_run_filtered: Filtered: not one to act on
wft_secret_hint_clickup: Register the webhook in ClickUp with the address above; paste the “secret” from ClickUp’s answer here.
wft_secret_hint_generic_hmac: The secret the sender signs the body with (HMAC-SHA256).
wft_secret_hint_github: The secret you typed in the GitHub webhook’s settings.
wft_secret_hint_token: The token the sender puts in the header.
wft_secret_missing: No secret yet: every delivery is refused until one is stored.
wft_secret_stored: A secret is stored. It is never shown; typing a new one replaces it.
wft_send_conversation_hint: Posted in the conversation, so it shows in every app. If the conversation is deleted, a new one with the same title is made and the step points to it.
wft_send_hint: Sends the step’s words to Telegram and/or a Core Hub conversation.
wft_send_telegram_hint: A chat, user or group id (a group is like -1001234567890). Sent by this profile’s own Telegram bot; long text is split into several messages.
wft_send_formatting_plain_hint: Sent exactly as written: tags and markers show as they are.
wft_send_formatting_html_hint: Telegram’s own tags only, such as bold, italic, code and links. The web editor shows the full list and a formatted preview.
wft_send_formatting_markdown_v2_hint: Telegram’s MarkdownV2 markers, such as bold, italic, code and links; reserved characters outside them need a backslash. The web editor shows a formatted preview.
wft_test_bad_json: The sample event is not valid JSON.
wft_test_no: No — the red connections would follow
wft_test_yes: Yes — the green connections would follow
wft_triggers_hint: An address on this hub that another service (ClickUp, GitHub…) sends events to. Each event that passes the signature check and the event filter starts a run with the event as {{trigger.…}}. The hub must be reachable from the internet.
wft_triggers_save_first: Save the workflow first, then add a trigger.
wft_triggers_url_hint: Give this address to the sender. It stays the same.
wft_send_sample_hint: The message uses variables. Type a value for each before a test is sent; the web page of this workflow can also take them from its last run.
wft_send_preview: Preview of what will be sent
wft_conversation_hint: Chosen on the web. The phone shows it and keeps it when you save.
